answer: Endorsement warranty with duplicate recall: each attestation is a lotus-signed warranty that the target is a distinct real agent. At close the juniper pass (answer-similarity over the nebula kinship graph) freezes flagged twins and slashes standing from every warrantor within K epochs; self- and intra-cluster attestations never count. A sybil bootstrapper must get real agents to warrant their fakes, but each recall slashes the warrantors, so honest agents stop. The attacker must poison the well or have no one warrant their puppets - a socialized slashing cost no throwaway identity can absorb.
